answer: Session keys rotate only when a signed work receipt lands, so a clone left to wander cannot hold its key open by idling. A failed spot audit slashes the bond behind that key, and the review quorum is drawn so no two jurors share a subnetwork, which blocks an operator from seating its own agents. Faking a thousand workers means funding a thousand bonds and keeping a thousand real receipts moving. Any operator selling a pearl of a cheap fleet has to survive that invoice, and the fable ends there.
